testing_progress.highlight: Repricing analysis ongoing on devnet-7; new state actor tool shows potentially worse numbers; full benchmark suite results expected next week
discv5-only mode ready for devnet-8; two clients still need flag to disable discv4; ENR fields not yet returned by admin_nodeInfo on any client — all EL teams should add ENR alongside eNode
Hive chain PR (#1589) blocked: clients disagree on EIP-7928 BAL contents at block 57; needs extra eyes to unblock

eip_proposals_hegota.highlight: EIP-8115: Batch priority fees at end of block; benefits parallel execution and UX; downside — priority fee only spendable next block
EIP-8116: Replace cumulative receipt gas field with per-tx gas; enables trust-minimized Merkle proofs without downloading two receipts
EIP-7807 (scoped-down): SSZ block hash only (no txs/receipts); lets CL compute block hash locally; removes logs bloom from header
EIP-7819 (SETDELEGATE): factory opcode creating 7702-style delegate pointers on-chain; makes proxy account creation composable and ~5x cheaper post-Glamsterdam repricing

EIP-7906 (Transaction Assertions via State Diff Opcode): post-tx frame with TXTRACE/TXDIFF opcodes to expose full state diff; allows wallets to enforce transaction outcomes on-chain; implemented in ethrex; Marius prefers a simpler TXDIFF-only interface
EIP-7668: Remove logs bloom filters; standalone EIP complementing EIP-8304 and EIP-7807; all clients still compute bloom unnecessarily

EIP-8200 (EVMification): replace unused precompiles with equivalent EVM bytecode; ~50% of precompiles barely used; BLS12 precompiles excluded from initial scope due to lack of optimized bytecode; EIP-7666 (EVMify IDENTITY) flagged as companion PFI

organizational.highlight: Hegota proposal deadline: submissions due by start of ACDC call next Thursday (via GitHub comment on ACDE agenda or PR against meta EIP)
Pooja: Glamsterdam EIPs need author approval on open PRs to move to Review; EIP-7773 meta EIP moves to Review only after all listed EIPs are in Review
